landing.hero_subtitle: The cultural rally of the Colonial Zone
landing.what_body: Turizoneando is a digital educational game experience that works from any web browser. Participants visit historic sites of the Colonial Zone, scan a QR code at each stop, listen to a narrated story, and answer questions to win prizes.
landing.cta_body: Join the most exciting cultural rally in the Colonial Zone.

register.title: Join the rally!
register.subtitle_2: Tell us a bit about you
register.rules_body:
To participate in the cultural rally you must:
• Visit each stop and scan the QR code.
• Listen to the narrated story of each site.
• Answer the questions correctly.
• Prizes are validated based on age and availability.
• One registration per email address.
